about: Shops, as the OSRS Wiki's shop pages give them: what each sells at, buys at and changes by per item of stock (tenths of a percent: the Wiki's 130.0% is 1300), its stock in the Wiki's order with each item's count and restock time in ticks, and the NPCs whose Trade opens it. inv and size are the shop's inv in the 241 cache (dump.inv). The Wiki gives a slot order only as its table's; the cache doesn't say. Every price follows from these numbers (see Shop.price), except an item with its own "price", which the Wiki gives and the percentages don't (Diango's Disk of Returning).
